# Two loads, one with a control-derived intercept.
exec pairedtiming -bootstrap 200 -seed 3 in.json
stdout '^ *a *x *1 *2 *1 *10 *5 *2.0000 *2.0000 *$'
stdout '^ *b *y *1 *2 *4.25 '
stdout '^score 1\.5385 \(geometric estimator, geometric mean over 2 loads\)$'
stdout 'blocks won 4, lost 0, sign test p=0.125'
stdout '95% block bootstrap \[1\.53'

# Sum estimator.
exec pairedtiming -bootstrap 0 -estimator sum in.json
stdout '^score .* \(sum estimator'
! stdout 'bootstrap'

# JSON output carries the per-block ratios.
exec pairedtiming -bootstrap 0 -json in.json
stdout '"ratios": \['
stdout '"speedup": 1.538'

# An intercept that reaches a sample is refused.
! exec pairedtiming bad.json
stderr 'sample not above intercept'

# Both an intercept and a control are ambiguous.
! exec pairedtiming both.json
stderr 'both intercept and control given'

# Unknown fields are refused.
! exec pairedtiming unknown.json
stderr 'unknown field'

-- in.json --
{"series": [
 {"name": "a", "load": "x", "weight": 1, "intercept": 1,
  "blocks": [[11, 6, 6, 11], [11, 6, 6, 11]]},
 {"name": "b", "load": "y", "weight": 1,
  "control": [[5.2, 6.1, 6.1, 5.2], [5.1, 6.1, 6.0, 5.2], [5.2, 6.2, 6.1, 5.1]],
  "blocks": [[24.3, 21.1, 21.2, 24.4], [24.1, 21.0, 21.3, 24.2]]}
]}
-- bad.json --
{"series": [{"name": "a", "load": "x", "weight": 1, "intercept": 6,
  "blocks": [[11, 6, 6, 11]]}]}
-- both.json --
{"series": [{"name": "a", "load": "x", "weight": 1, "intercept": 1,
  "control": [[5, 6, 6, 5]], "blocks": [[11, 6, 6, 11]]}]}
-- unknown.json --
{"series": [{"name": "a", "load": "x", "weight": 1, "blockz": []}]}
